column1: # Every translator upstream declares, so gate G4 ("all translators registered and
# reached; MissingTranslators empty") is COMPUTED rather than remembered. Vendored so
# no test step needs the read-only ~/GitHome/lilypond tree (standing rule 7).
#   cpp     ADD_TRANSLATOR       -- a concrete engraver or performer
#   group   ADD_TRANSLATOR_GROUP -- a translator GROUP (Engraver_group etc.)
#   scheme  ly:register-translator in scm/ -- a Scheme-implemented translator
# NOTE: the condensed plan says "34 Scheme"; the real figure is 37
